statements.t: Alongside continued accumulation, the Company expects to report substantial growth in its per-share metrics and a stronger balance sheet as of September 30, 2026.
Based on preliminary estimates, the Company expects to report the following changes as of September 30, 2026, compared with August 12, 2026:
We expect to report double digit growth in SOL per share and more than a doubling of NAV per share since our August update.
The Company intends to continue accumulating SOL through disciplined capital deployment and organic treasury growth, while putting its holdings to work through staking and validator operations.
The anticipated September 30 metrics are preliminary, remain subject to finalization, and may differ from the Company’s final reported results.

Instead, they are based only on the Company's current beliefs, expectations, and assumptions regarding the future of its business, future plans and strategies, projections, anticipated events and trends, the economy, and other future conditions.
